about: The scored pruning set (roadmap B-121, feeding B-046's report): golden questions over small group-history corpora. 'relevant' positions are HUMAN-marked — the chunks a person says answer the question. 'judgements' are the recorded judge's kept positions, replayed through the real engine by pruning_evaluation.py, so recall and precision measure the engine end to end. One case carries a deliberate judge miss: an evaluation that cannot show a failure is not an evaluation.

chunks.text: Quiz rota: Ben brings the cards, Cy scores.
The tea urn needs descaling before winter.
Agreed then: the hall, not the school gym, for club nights.
Raffle tickets are in the blue tin on the shelf.
Who left the ladder in the corridor again?
Reminder: the hall keys live with Ana on club nights.
The notice board has been repainted at last.
Soup rota for November is on the fridge door.
Tickets for the raffle go on sale Friday.
Supper food: soup first, then pies — no shellfish, ever, for Mara.
The projector bulb has been replaced.
Chairs: we need forty, the school lends twenty.
Dessert is covered — Tomas brings the apple cake for the supper.
Guttering over the porch still leaks.
New members night moved to the second Tuesday.
The van passed its inspection, thankfully.
Drinks for the supper: tea and squash only, the hall licence says so.
Lost property box is by the door if anyone asks.

cases.question: What did we decide about food for the supper?

chunks.text: Jonas has the marquee in his barn and will bring it Saturday morning.
The quiz final is postponed a week.
Paint for the hall door: green, not blue.
Someone borrowed the extension lead and kept it.
Harvest supper tickets are five pounds this year.
The choir needs the piano tuned before October.
Groundsheets travel with the marquee — Jonas keeps them together.
Bins go out Thursday night now, not Friday.
The spare keys are cut and in the office drawer.

cases.question: Who is bringing the marquee and when?

chunks.text: Summer fete planning starts next week.
The hall floor has been sanded and looks lovely.
Poster ink is running low again.
Careful: the marquee flooded the last time it rained at Greenfield.
Tea towels have been washed and ironed.
The raffle drum needs a new handle.
Band practice moves to Wednesdays in July.
The lane to Greenfield floods too — come in by the top gate after rain.
New glasses for the kitchen arrive Monday.
The notice board key is with the caretaker.
Mind the low beam in the barn doorway, it has caught three foreheads.
Winter rota draft is on the table for comments.

cases.question: What warnings were given about the venue?
